requirements.description: User prefers energy class D or better, so all classes from A1 to D are accepted. Area, capacity and green-space requirements are not energy-related and were not extracted.
User prefers properties near green spaces. Using the 75th percentile of the green distribution (74.26), rounded to 74.

The user explicitly requires at least 600 sqm of gross floor area, which maps directly to surface_area. The capacity of 45 people is not a surface measure and is not converted into an area filter. Energy class and proximity to green spaces are not reference columns and are not applied.

output.sql: SELECT * FROM ESTATES WHERE property_type = 'Attività scolastiche' AND surface_area >= 600 AND energy_class IN ('A1', 'A2', 'A3', 'A4', 'B', 'C', 'D') AND green >= 74 AND haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) <= 3.0 ORDER BY haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) ASC
output.explanation: Filters on school property type, gross surface of at least 600 sqm, energy class A1 through D, green score of at least 74, and a 3.0 km radius around the supplied coordinates. Results are ordered by distance from those coordinates. The capacity requirement (45 people) has no matching column in the allowlist, so it is not applied.
